title: Vanguard’s Journey
description: Mechanical Desolation is a hardcore engineering and exploration experience built on the Fabric loader. It merges the complex automation of Create with the unforgiving environments of The BetterNether...
body:
Project Description (English):

STRICTLY FOR TESTING: ALPHA PHASE
This modpack is currently in active development.

    State of the Pack: Many features, custom recipes, and end-game goals are still being worked on.

    Stability: Expect  and mod conflicts.


The Vision:
Inspired by the "Homestead" and "RLCraft" styles, this pack strips away the ease of vanilla Minecraft. With a focus on Create and its many addons, you must build complex kinetic systems to survive a hostile environment. 

Key Features (Alpha Version):

    The Age of Gears: Master the Create mod to automate resource gathering and survival.

    Hell Reimagined: Deep exploration of the BetterNether with new structures and dangers.

    Brutal Combat: Features Better Combat and Bosses of Mass Destruction for a soul-like fighting experience.

    Hardcore Immersion: Enhanced by AmbientSounds, Physics Mod, and various visual overhauls for a heavy, atmospheric feel.

Technical Requirements:

    RAM: 6GB - 8GB+ is highly recommended.

    Version: Fabric Loader 0.18.4 (MC 1.20.1).

    Bugs: Please report any issues



### Credits

- **Create** by Creators of Create: [Modrinth Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- **AmbientSounds** by CreativeMD: [Modrinth Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds)
- **BetterNether** by Paulevs: [Modrinth Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether)
- **Better Combat** by ZsoltMolnarrr: [Modrinth Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)
- **Physics Mod** by Haubna: [Modrinth Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/physics-mod)
- **Optimization Suite (Sodium, Lithium)** by caffeine-mc: [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) and more
